_注释: 平台商品图规格表。gallery=画廊主图位，detail=详情宽幅图位。out_px 为最终交付像素（本地后处理到精确值）。main_rules 写主图硬规则，供自检判定。

gallery.label: 白底主图
gallery.bg_prompt: a pure clean white seamless studio background, empty, no product, no object
gallery.prompt: on a pure clean {BG} background, product centered and filling about 85% of the frame, straight front view, professional e-commerce main product photo, crisp even studio lighting

gallery.label: 产品展示图
gallery.bg_prompt: an empty premium studio background with a soft neutral gradient and a subtle floor reflection area, no product, no object, soft even lighting
gallery.prompt: as an attractive product beauty shot on a soft neutral studio background with a subtle gradient and a gentle soft shadow, slightly angled composition, professional lighting

gallery.label: 场景图
gallery.bg_prompt: an empty tasteful lifestyle scene background relevant to this product category, no product, no object, clear space in the centre for a product, soft natural light
gallery.prompt: placed into a natural, tasteful lifestyle scene relevant to this type of product, photorealistic, the product is the clear focus, soft natural light

gallery.label: 使用场景
gallery.bg_prompt: an empty realistic everyday environment background suitable for this product, no product, no object, clear middle area, natural lighting
gallery.prompt: shown being used in a realistic everyday context suitable for this product, photorealistic lifestyle photo, the product is the focus

gallery.label: 细节特写
gallery.bg_prompt: a clean softly-lit minimal background with subtle depth of field, no product, no object
gallery.prompt: a close-up macro shot highlighting the material, texture and craftsmanship of the product, clean softly-lit background, shallow depth of field

detail.label: 主卖点
detail.bg_prompt: an empty wide cinematic modern gradient background, no product, no object, generous clean space, premium lighting
detail.prompt: a wide cinematic hero banner featuring the exact product as the focus on a clean modern gradient background, premium e-commerce marketing layout with generous space for a headline

detail.label: 卖点场景1
detail.bg_prompt: an empty wide lifestyle scene background relevant to this product category, no product, no object, clear centre space, soft depth of field
detail.prompt: a wide lifestyle banner featuring the exact product in an appealing usage scene, premium e-commerce detail image, soft depth of field, space for text

detail.label: 卖点场景2
detail.bg_prompt: an empty wide stylish surface background with complementary props and elegant lighting, no product, no object, clear centre space
detail.prompt: a wide banner presenting the exact product on a stylish surface with complementary props, editorial e-commerce detail image, elegant lighting, space for text

detail.label: 生活方式
detail.bg_prompt: an empty wide warm living environment background with natural light, no product, no object, clear centre space
detail.prompt: a wide lifestyle banner showing the exact product integrated into a real living environment, warm natural light, aspirational mood, space for text

detail.label: 参数信息图
detail.bg_prompt: an empty wide light minimal background, no product, no object, thin divider space
detail.prompt: as a wide clean modern e-commerce specification infographic: the exact product shown prominently on a light minimal background with tidy room for specification callouts and thin divider lines

fonts._注释: 字体解析顺序：skill assets/fonts/*.ttf → 系统字体 → Pillow 内置。CJK/西里尔目标市场建议放一个 Arial Unicode 或 Noto Sans 进 assets/fonts。
